The kill condition required a single cell with positive Calmar on at least five of the nine symbols and a liquidation on none. Six of the nine symbols - SOLUSDT -0.0399, AVAXUSDT -0.0612, BNBUSDT -0.1204, ADAUSDT -0.1676, ETHUSDT -0.1691, DOGEUSDT -0.2929 - have no positive cell at any point in the 972-trial grid. The arithmetic ceiling for any single cell is therefore three symbols, and five is unreachable. The condition is met and the family closes.

What happened to the three that were positive is the more informative part. BTCUSDT +0.2433, LTCUSDT +0.0464 and XRPUSDT +0.0386 are not one cell but three different parameter sets, so even the ceiling of three is not a rule, it is three separate corners. All three are shape SPIKE and all three sit in negative neighbourhoods: the mean of the cells adjacent to the peak is -0.115 for BTCUSDT, -1.867 for LTCUSDT and -4.772 for XRPUSDT. A peak whose neighbours are an order of magnitude worse and of the opposite sign is a grid corner, not a mechanism. The parameters chosen say the same thing: the winning cells cluster at the extreme of every axis the grid offered - the richest entry rate 0.0002, the smallest exposure 0.25, and lookback_days at whichever end of 7/21/60 the symbol happened to prefer.

The overfitting diagnostics agree. PBO is 0.647 on XRPUSDT, which is above the 0.5 line at which selection carries no information at all, and 0.321 and 0.357 on BTCUSDT and LTCUSDT - SELECTION_WEAK, not informative. Each symbol contributes one equity curve over one history, with an independent-path bound between 2 and 56 depending on the symbol, so the ranking above was drawn from very few genuinely separate experiments.

The mechanism failed for the reason the pre-registered claim itself flagged as the open question: whether the tax could be collected without the directional move that produces it taking the position first. It could not. Shorting on a rich trailing settlement rate puts the coupon and the directional exposure on opposite sides of the book by construction - the rule is short exactly when leveraged long demand is strongest, which is exactly when price is rising. Funding at the baseline 0.01 percent per eight hours is roughly 11 percent a year; the adverse move over a holding period of days to weeks is a multiple of that. No combination of stop, exposure or holding limit in the grid separated the two, and the failure is monotone across the universe rather than concentrated in one regime or one symbol. KT-1 established that long perpetual accumulation pays a structural tax. H0002 establishes that standing on the receiving side of that same tax, unhedged and short-only, does not collect it.
